# mcp/tests/fixtures/l109_tool_answers/PROVENANCE.md

## Governing Overview

[Owning route overview](../../overview.md)

## Purpose

Own the production-versus-recorded provenance and supported regeneration policy of the L109 answer-table fixtures.

## Code Commentary

The four tools have ordinary and largest-case samples. The three operation-produced largest samples use named producers for twenty-path naming, a delivered knowledge page and a memory comparison. Recorded samples remain recorded; their historical roots/builds/logs do not attest a live run.

Sanitization replaces selected volatile scratch/date/detail values for production pins while preserving other produced bytes. Regeneration is a hermetic pytest operation with the dedicated opt-in variable; curation does not regenerate or rewrite accepted fixture output. The lifecycle/base metadata remains evidence provenance, not a new code commit or acceptance.

## Evidence

- The fixture account distinguishes recorded samples, named operation producers and regeneration. [1]
